products.short_description: Run migration cutover operations tool-agnostically — wave batching, throttling/API-limit management, pre-stage/delta/cutover sequencing, post-migration validation, and hypercare triage — so cutovers finish clean with evidence. products.description:
Run migration cutovers on rails — waved, throttled, and validated

A migration plan isn't a migration execution. This solution is the tool-agnostic cutover operations layer that sits over whatever engine you use: batch users into waves, manage throttling and API limits (Microsoft & Google), sequence pre-stage → delta → cutover, run post-migration validation (item counts, permissions, mail flow, delegates), and drive hypercare issue triage — so cutovers finish clean with evidence, not surprises.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the cutover-ops model: wave batching, throttling/API-limit management, pre-stage/delta/cutover sequencing, validation, and hypercare — tool-agnostic.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (a chosen migration engine, M365 + Google admin access, user/wave data, validation criteria, hypercare team).
  • Implementation Guide — build wave batches, set throttling/limit strategy, sequence pre-stage/delta/cutover, run post-migration validation, and operate hypercare triage — pilot-first, each wave named.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (waves cut over clean, validation passes, issues triaged within SLA) plus Best Practices for throttling and cutover sequencing.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Cutovers run on rails — users waved, throttling managed, pre-stage/delta/cutover sequenced, and every migration validated with evidence — clean finishes, not surprises.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • cutover-readiness.py — pre-cutover go/no-go checks for a migration wave (read-only)
    • discovery-profile.py — profile a migration discovery user-set and flag missing batching attributes
    • throttle-planner.py — budget migration concurrency/pacing against Microsoft Graph + Google API limits
    • validate-migration.py — post-migration validation report + hypercare issue triage (read-only)
    • wave-batcher.py — build dependency-aware, size-limited migration waves from a discovery user-set

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
